objects.name: Analytic 1664
objects.description: For iOS, detect One-Way Communication by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Application Vetting [Code-signing entitlements and Info.plist privacy usage-description keys]; Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; Network Traffic Content via Enterprise Secure Web Gateway / Proxy [DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Apps approved for periodic read access to each platform. News readers (RSS/social), weather apps — legitimate pollers. Unknown apps periodically polling paste/code platforms are anomalous.
Default 900s (15 min) maximum interval between fetches to same platform from background. More frequent background polling without user activity = C2 check-in.
Default 30s between platform content retrieval and behavioral change (new connection, file write). Command processing is near-synchronous.
